title: 六上 · 校园日常训练卷
scope: be动词、代词、名词与基础信息阅读；原创能力训练顺序，教材单元对应待核实。
language: My two cousins [[1]] in the school hall.
主语 two cousins 是复数，be 用 are。
is 与这里的复数主语不一致。
am 只与主语 I 搭配。
This is [[1]] pencil. It belongs to me.
空格后有名词 pencil，需要形容词性物主代词 my。
mine 通常独立使用，不能在这里直接修饰 pencil。
I 是主格，不表示这里的所属关系。
There are four [[1]] on the desk.
four 后需要复数；box 的复数是 boxes。
box 是单数，与 four 不符。
box 以 -x 结尾，规则复数加 -es，不是只加 -s。
具体钟点 nine o'clock 前用 at。
on 常用于具体日期等，这里是钟点。
in 常用于月份、季节等，这里是钟点。
Look at these shoes. [[1]] are blue.
these shoes 是复数，用 They 指代。
It 指单数，不能指代这里的 shoes。
This 表单数，与 these shoes 不一致。
这里填国名：My friend lives in [[1]].
China 是国家名称，在这里作 in 的宾语。
Chinese 可表示汉语、中国人或中国的，这里题目要求国名。
China's 是所有格形式，不能在此独立表示题目要求的国家名称。
There are [[1]] books here: ten on this shelf and ten on that one.
两处各十本，合计二十本，英语是 twenty。
twelve 是十二，与十加十不符。
thirty 是三十，原句只给出两个十。
祈使句通常以动词原形开始，这里用 Be。
Is 不是动词原形，不能这样作祈使句的开头。
Are 不能替代这里祈使句所需的原形 Be。

cloze.text: Mia is in a new school. She has a small map in her bag. The map is 〔1〕_____, just like the sky on a clear day. Her classroom is beside the 〔2〕_____. There are many books in that room. Mia cannot find her classroom at first. A girl stops to 〔3〕_____ her. 'I am in your class,' the girl says. They go to the room 〔4〕_____. Mia is not alone now. She puts the map on her desk and says 〔5〕_____ to the girl.
items: blue
green
red
just like the sky on a clear day
晴天的天空这一线索指向 blue。
green 是绿色，与晴天天空的常见颜色线索不符。
red 是红色，原文没有红色的依据。
library
playground
kitchen
There are many books in that room.
房间里有很多书，结合选项应是 library。
playground 是操场，不是这个放很多书的房间。
kitchen 是厨房，不能由许多书这一线索推出。
help
lose
hide
Mia cannot find her classroom at first.
Mia 找不到教室，同班女孩停下来帮她。
lose 表丢失，不表示女孩帮助找教室。
hide 表躲藏，与后文一起去教室不符。
together
yesterday
again
Mia is not alone now.
Mia 不再独自一人，说明两人一起去。
yesterday 表昨天，不符合正在发生的故事顺序。
again 表再次，原文没有两人之前已去过一次的依据。
thank you
good night
see you
A girl stops to 〔3〕_____ her.
女孩提供帮助后，Mia 应表示感谢。
good night 用于晚间道别等，不符合这里感谢帮助的目的。
see you 用于告别，而这里两人刚一起到教室，不是在道别。

reading.text:
ART ROOM NOTE
Our art room is open on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons. Tuesday's activity is drawing leaves. Thursday's activity is making paper birds. Both activities start at four and finish at five. Bring a pencil on Tuesday. The teacher has paper for everyone on both days. Please leave food and drinks outside the room. You can put your bag under your chair. At the end, put the pencils back in the box near the door.
items: What do students make on Thursday?
Paper birds.
Leaf drawings.
Wooden boxes.
Thursday's activity is making paper birds.
Thursday 对应纸鸟制作。
叶子绘画是周二的活动。
盒子用来放铅笔，不是周四制作的物品。
How long is each activity?
One hour.
Two hours.
Four hours.
Both activities start at four and finish at five.
四点至五点相差一小时。
两个开门日不等于每次活动两小时。
four 表开始钟点，不是持续四小时。
What should a student bring on Tuesday?
A pencil.
Paper for everyone.
A drink for the room.
Bring a pencil on Tuesday.
原文明示周二带铅笔。
纸由老师提供。
饮料要留在室外，不能据此选带入房间的饮料。
Where do the pencils go at the end?
In the box near the door.
Under the chair.
Outside with the drinks.
put the pencils back in the box near the door.
结束时铅笔放回门边的盒子。
椅子下面是放书包的位置。
食物饮料留在室外，不是铅笔的归还处。

reading.text: Ben has a little desk by the window. There are three cups on it, but none is for drinking. The yellow cup is for pencils. The white cup is for small pieces of paper. Ben puts old buttons in the red cup. He makes pictures with the buttons and paper. His sister calls the desk messy. Ben shows her a picture of a red bus. 'I can find what I need,' he says. His sister smiles and asks for a button picture of her own.
items: What is in the red cup?
Old buttons.
Drinking water.
Pencils.
Ben puts old buttons in the red cup.
红色杯子装旧纽扣。
原文说这些杯子都不是用来喝水的。
铅笔放在黄色杯子中。
Where is Ben's desk?
By the window.
Behind the school.
Inside a bus.
Ben has a little desk by the window.
开头直接交代桌子靠窗。
文中未提到桌子在学校后面。
公交车是图片中的内容，不是桌子的位置。
What does Ben make with the buttons and paper?
Pictures.
New cups.
School windows.
He makes pictures with the buttons and paper.
纽扣与纸用来做画。
杯子是整理物品的容器，文中没有制作新杯子。
窗户是位置线索，不是制作的物品。
What does the sister ask for at the end?
A button picture.
A red bus ride.
A cup of water.
His sister smiles and asks for a button picture of her own.
结尾她想要一幅自己的纽扣画。
红公交是 Ben 展示的画，不是乘车请求。
文中明确杯子不是喝水用的，也没有这个请求。

task.text:
READING CORNER
The reading corner is in Room 12. It is open at lunchtime on Wednesday. You may read there or take one book back to class. Write your first name on the card before taking a book. Return the book on Friday. Please keep the card in the room.
items: The reading corner is in Room _____. 只填阿拉伯数字。
The reading corner is in Room 12.
房间号是12，不是开放的星期或归还时间。
The corner is open on _____. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
Wednesday
It is open at lunchtime on Wednesday.
开放日是周三；周五是还书日。
Before taking a book, write your first _____ on the card. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
name
Write your first name on the card before taking a book.
在 first 后填 name，组成 first name。

writing.stem: 写一张约35—50词的英文便条，邀请朋友周四放学后参加绘画活动。说明16:00在美术教室集合、带铅笔、请朋友告诉你能否参加。可用虚构名字，不写真实联系方式。
writing.model:
Hi Lily,
Would you like to draw with me after school on Thursday? Please meet me in the art room at four in the afternoon. Bring a pencil. We can draw some leaves together. Please tell me if you can come.
See you,
Tom
points: 周四放学后16:00在美术教室
writing.organisation: 先邀请，再写集合信息和物品，最后请对方回复。
writing.language: 检查 be、代词、星期与钟点的表达；句子完整，标点清楚。
writing.format: 便条有合理称呼和结束语
writing.pitfall: 不能漏掉集合地点或回复请求；不必照抄参考中的名字和绘画内容。
